adjudicated_statement: Work over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Let H=H_{4,6}(P^1) be the Deligne-Mumford stack of finite degree-four covers of a fixed P^1 by smooth connected genus-six curves, and let H^bal be the open locus where the Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle is isomorphic to O(4)+O(5). Then H^bal is smooth of pure dimension 18 (FND-0159, FND-0162, FND-0163). Let Z be the stack-level ordered reduced-support Casnati-Ekedahl model over H^bal: the finite etale S_6-torsor of orderings of the reduced-support open U of the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle P(pi_*L). That bundle is smooth of relative dimension two, U is nonempty and dense in every fibre (FND-0134), and the ordering torsor is finite etale, so Z is smooth of pure dimension 18+2=20. Let f:Z->M_{6,6} be the classifying morphism of the tautological six-pointed smooth genus-six curve constructed in ATT-0120/CLM-0120-1, and let Y be the reduced closed substack of M_{6,6} whose underlying space is the Zariski closure of the geometric image of f (equivalently, of any smooth finite-type scheme atlas of Z; atlas independence as in CLM-0120-2). Then f is locally of finite type and quasi-DM, hence dim Y<=dim Z=20. Independently, M_{6,6} is a smooth Deligne-Mumford stack of dimension 3*6-3+6=21. Therefore dim Y<=20<21, Y is a proper closed substack, and U_Y:=M_{6,6} minus Y is a nonempty dense open. In particular the kernel-form CE support term T_Z:=ker(T->W_{26}H^{26}(U_Y;Q)(21)) of ATT-0120 is not forced to equal T by emptiness of the complement: the geometric degeneration Y=M_{6,6} does not occur. This does not assert the cohomological support-exhaustion T_Z=T, nor that restriction to U_Y is nonzero on T; those remain separate inputs as in FND-0168(3a). The bound dim Y<=20 is not asserted to be sharp: the classifying image is PGL_2-invariant, Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2] has dimension 15, and the corresponding model has dimension 17. No closed embedding of Z, regular immersion, Gysin map, or Tate type is asserted.
contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the geometric properness of Y does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Local originating artifacts were checked first. ATT-0120 Section 8 explicitly disclaims dimension of Y, equidimensionality of Y, and dim Y=17, while constructing Y as the reduced Zariski closure of the finite-type classifying image of the ordered reduced-support model; the degenerate reading Y=M_{6,6} is therefore unaddressed in the attempt, which is the gap REV-0169 records. REV-0169 candidate ce-classifying-image-closure-proper-in-m66 supplies the 18+2=20 count from CLM-0112-2 plus relative dimension two of the reduced-support open of the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle, and its last sentence claims that any kernel-form CE support datum is therefore a genuine proper-support term and cannot degenerate into unnoticed support-exhaustion T_Z=T. That last clause overstates. Geometric properness of Y rules out only the unnoticed degeneration in which U_Y is empty and r_T=0 identically, which would force T_Z=T with no cohomological content. FND-0168(3a), already corroborated, records that T_Z=T can still hold for a proper closed Y, because restriction T->W_{26}H^{26}(U_Y;Q)(21) may vanish on a nonempty dense open; support-exhaustion remains a separate C66-TATE-ASSEMBLY input. The dimension count itself is independently confirmed. Hacking, Algebra Number Theory 2 (2008), 809-818, and arXiv math/0509567v2 Section 2: the stack of stable n-pointed genus-g curves is a smooth proper Deligne-Mumford stack of dimension 3g-3+n, so dim Mbar_{6,6}=21 and the open smooth locus M_{6,6} has the same dimension; Wikipedia Moduli space, section Moduli of curves, records the same formula for M_{g,n}. FND-0159/FND-0162/FND-0163 give H and H^bal smooth of pure dimension 18 (normal-sheaf length 2d+2g-2=18 at (d,g)=(4,6)), matching CLM-0112-2. A Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle is smooth of relative dimension two, so Stacks tag 0AFE yields dimension 20 for the Abel-Jacobi bundle; FND-0134 makes the reduced-support open dense in every fibre, and the S_6-ordering torsor is finite etale, so the stack-level ordered model over H^bal has dimension 20. ATT-0120 constructs f from a finite-type scheme atlas, hence a locally finite-type quasi-DM morphism to the quasi-separated stack M_{6,6}; Stacks tag 0DS6 (Lemma 107.5.24) gives dim of the scheme-theoretic image at most dim of the source, and Stacks 0DRY that a closed immersion does not increase dimension, so dim Y<=20<21. Compatible with FND-0052 (the reduced-support model is an open piece of the failure locus, not itself a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6}: Y is a closure, still proper). Compatible with FND-0168(5b), which names a 17-dimensional Gysin source as an undischarged closed-embedding obligation rather than a proved upper bound on the classifying image. Compatible with FND-0147 (representable unramified quasi-finite monomorphism after pencil reconstruction), which would make dim of image equal dim of the PGL_2-quotiented 17-dimensional model and is not used here, matching ATT-0120's refusal of the monomorphism route. Compatible with FND-0171 (A of dimension 17 over a pure-dimension-15 atlas of Hbar^bal). The 20-bound is valid but not sharp: ATT-0120 already records PGL_2-invariance of the image, Hbar^bal has dimension 15, and the corresponding model has dimension 17. Distinct from FND-0168: do not merge. Promote from candidate to corroborated on independent primary-source verification of dim M_{6,6}=21, of dim(image)<=dim(source) for quasi-DM finite-type morphisms, and of the 18+2 source dimension; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source. The last sentence of the candidate text is corrected in the adjudicated statement.
